board_b.name: Power + Stereo Class-D
owns: 12 V-class to 5 V buck and Board A delivery
TAS5825M and two BTL speaker outputs
local default-off PDN gate and fault response

components.microphone: IM73A135V01 provisional; four electrically equivalent channels

clock.audio_pll: RT1062 PLL4 candidate, one frequency family for both SAI modules
clock.r4_open: exact crystal, PLL/dividers, SAI pin mux, phase and startup timing

boot.direction: native NXP RT1062 Boot ROM plus external FlexSPI NOR XIP
boot.flash_candidate: ISSI IS25WP064AJBLE-class 1.8 V 64 Mbit / 8 MiB EVK baseline
boot.factory: ROM USB/UART flashloader with SWD/JTAG pogo recovery
boot.field: wired USB service capability, exact update/security/rollback policy open

power.board_b_input: protected nominal 12 V class, final headroom open
power.r4_open: input envelope, load/current and tolerance, sequencing, converter/protection parts

safety.board_b_default: TAS PDN low on power-off/open cable/invalid PGOOD
safety.board_a_independent_monitor: heartbeat-gated AMP_MUTE/ENABLE permission; internal RT1062 WDOG alone insufficient
safety.amp_reset_state: Deep Sleep until configured; I2C Play only after READY
safety.fault_rule: B local hard fault/PGOOD loss forces PDN low without waiting for A software
safety.recovery: return through BOOT_SAFE/SELF_TEST; timing and latch policy R4

open_architecture_dependencies: R4 SAI PLL/pin/loaded timing and end-to-end latency
R4 exact flash/boot/security and production sign-off
R4 independent safe-state response and fault recovery
